Run targeted task/schema tests and evaluation tests per backend, `mix q`, and `git diff --check`. Preserve the earlier volume-environment isolation for test database provisioning. Complete applicable review/coverage phases and final `mix precommit` per workflow before final approval. Do not rerun browser E2E for this developer-only change. Fixture parsing and file updates are local-only developer tooling; no new agent tools or production retrieval behavior. Read applicable AGENTS.md policies before implementation. Do not skip missing vectors or weaken relevance assertions.
